name: @everfur/mcp

tools.name: everfur_plan_integration
tools.description: Produce an integration plan for a project. REFUSES underspecified input by naming the missing facts rather than guessing them. Read-only; touches no network and no credential.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project being integrated.

capabilities.description: Which Everfur capabilities this integration uses. Omit if unknown; the tool will refuse and say so.

identity_mode.description: anonymous = no backend, scoped to the device. partner-user-ref = your backend mints a session against your own user id. "personalized" is accepted as an alias for partner-user-ref.

session_mint_language.description: Backend language that will mint sessions. Only meaningful when identity_mode is partner-user-ref.

contract_path.description: Path to a contract-public projection. Defaults to EVERFUR_CONTRACT_PUBLIC.

tools.name: everfur_verify_integration
tools.description: Mint a session, poll entitlements, and hard-assert the verdict is not empty. Returns PASS/SKIP/FAIL per step with the request id of the call that produced it. Mints a real session, so it is not read-only, but it creates no partner-visible data.

user_ref.description: End-user id to mint the test session for. Defaults to a CLI-owned value.

attempts.description: How many times to read the verdict before concluding it is empty.

tools.name: everfur_diagnose
tools.description: Separate the four byte-identical causes of an empty entitlement verdict. Read-only. Reports honestly when the deployment does not serve the diagnostics route rather than relaying a bare 404.

tools.name: everfur_send_test_message
tools.description: Send a REAL message and stream a real veterinary answer, against a SANDBOX tenant only. Refuses unless the entitlement verdict reports livemode false. Returns the answer plus a frame histogram, so a stream that died mid-answer is distinguishable from a short one.

message.description: What to ask. A real pet-health question gets a real answer.

idempotency_key.description: Required and explicit. The caller owns it, so a retried tool call cannot silently become a second message in the conversation.

pet_ref.description: Optional pet to scope the conversation to. Must already be registered.

instructions:
Everfur partner integration tools.

Everfur is a pet-health API. Partners embed chat and medical-records surfaces in their own apps via
@everfur/sdk (React Native).

Use everfur_plan_integration FIRST. It refuses underspecified input by naming exactly which facts are
missing. When it refuses, ask the developer those specific questions and call it again. Do not guess the
answers and do not proceed without them: an integration built on a guessed identity mode is wrong in a way
that only shows up in production.

Then everfur_verify_integration to exercise the real wire, and everfur_diagnose when a working integration
stops returning capabilities.
